versions.changelog: Add security scanning notes and clarifying comments for base64 auth pattern
Fix: Add explicit requirements and security declarations to SKILL.md frontmatter to align with security scanner expectations
Added background mode with bg-list/bg-status/bg-logs, configurable max runtime, short commands (cca), and improved security

v1.2.7: Workspace restructuring

- Added cca-comprehensive-test.sh to .gitignore (local dev only)
- Repository structure optimized for development workflow

v1.2.6: Cleaned for public release

- Removed all internal PAR- ticket references from code comments
- Removed internal comprehensive test file (had hardcoded paths)
- Fixed validate.sh command reference
- Repository now contains only user-facing content
- No internal development discussions or bug references in shipped code

v1.2.4: All fixes complete - PAR-150, PAR-151, PAR-152, PAR-153

PAR-150: Model parameter now optional with default gpt-5.2. User sees which model is being used.
PAR-151: Improved HTTP 400 error messages with API error details.
PAR-152: Added agent state validation before followup - clear error for FINISHED/STOPPED agents.
PAR-153: Documented flag position requirement in help text.

All tested with real Cursor Cloud Agents API usage.

v1.2.3: Fix API request format (PAR-149)

Critical fix for launch command:
- Use source.repository (not target.repo)
- Use prompt.text object (not string)
- Verified working with real-world test
- Agent successfully created PR #1 on test repo

v1.2.2: Fix Clawhub summary display

- Added YAML frontmatter to SKILL.md with description field
- Clawhub now displays summary in search results

v1.2.1: Add clawdhub summary metadata

- Verified skill.json includes summary for search results display
- CURSOR_API_BASE naming confirmed (URL override, separate from CURSOR_API_KEY)

v1.2.0: Critical bug fixes and reliability improvements

- Fixed duplicate JSON key bug in cmd_launch (PAR-140)
- Separated curl stderr for proper error handling (PAR-141)

- Added CURSOR_API_BASE env var for testing (PAR-144)

- Better error messages when API key not found
- Updated documentation with all authentication options
